## Tech workers

Run the stated-vs-demonstrated audit on your own product: what do the defaults, dark patterns, and data practices *demonstrate*, whatever the values page states? Apply Romans 13:10 as an acceptance test to data collection, privacy, and algorithmic decisions: does this harm the neighbor it touches? Then bring forward your Module 4 wisdom-feature sketch and Module 5 Design Guide map — this module gives them their organizing value.
